propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a concurrent slot against a 20-slot GitHub Free cap and runs duplicate test coverage already provided by _build-and-test.yml matrix cells
Deleting the import-linter job risks silent removal of optionality test collection if future edits add pytest markers or move the test files without an explicit guard

A durable checked-in test must assert that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py remain collected under the default suite selection (-m 'not integration and not external') with exactly 9 items
The collection guard test must be sensitive to marker additions (file-level pytestmark, decorators, or conftest-applied marks) that would exclude either file from default selection
The import-linter job deletion requires updating infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json to remove the stale check context to prevent rollback script failures
